description: Permission Passport: issue a signed (Ed25519), expiring, job-scoped permission ticket for an agent: which tools, which hosts (plus explicit denies), how much it may spend, for how long (max 7 days). Carries permissions, never credentials. Any tool can check it with /passport/check or verify it offline with the public key. Limits damage when an agent is hijacked. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/passport/issue, $0.002 via x402.)
name: passport_issue
